There was no red carpet and no announcement — unusual for a star who has historically timed her reinventions to album rollouts. Swift, who married Travis Kelce in July, let the sidewalk photos do all the talking.

## First Real Outing: A Friend’s Wedding [...] Taylor Swift stepped out in London last week with her shortest hair in years — and within hours the internet had split into three camps: the fans who call it her biggest style shake-up in years, the skeptics who insist scissors were never involved, and the theorists who are certain it means her 13th album is on the way.

## A Quiet Debut in London
results.title: Taylor Swift New Haircut Fuels TS13 Rumors
